Reviewed `817da6f` and left 1 comment: 1 issue (**1 blocking**).

review_comments.body: issue: method overridden without calling super - as a result, focusVisible: true does nothing and focus-ring attribute is not set.
issue: method overridden without calling `super` - as a result, `focusVisible: true` does nothing and `focus-ring` attribute is not set.
suggestion: add `if (!this.disabled)` check to align with some other components.
suggestion: could also check for `__selectedRadioButton` here. When the group is now disabled, selected radio button must be always enabled anyway.

```suggestion
     * Override method inherited from `FocusMixin` to move focus 
     * to the checked radio button, or to the first enabled one.
```

```suggestion
     * Override method inherited from `FocusMixin`
     * to move focus to the first enabled checkbox.
```

comments.body:
Thanks for the review. Pushed a follow-up commit that addresses all points:

- `focus()` in radio-group and checkbox-group now calls `super.focus(options)`, so `focusVisible: true` sets the `focus-ring` attribute (new tests cover it).
- Added the `if (this.disabled) return;` guard.
- Radio-group prefers `__selectedRadioButton` when it is enabled, otherwise the first enabled one.
- Applied the JSDoc wording suggestion.

This comment was drafted with AI assistance (Claude Code) and reviewed before posting.

Thanks, fixed in e1161b1: `super.focus(options)` is now only called when an option is focusable, so a group with all options disabled no longer gets `focus-ring`. Added a test for both radio-group and checkbox-group.

(This reply was drafted with Claude Code assistance and has not been manually reviewed.)
